overall_assessment: Reviewed all eight random-control plan excerpts, including the packet-capped M30-LUN excerpt, and all three failed-fetch entries. No pre-pass flags were raised; the displayed plans match their course codes, retain readable sections and facts, and have no reported uncaptured text or visible site chrome, with only occasional metadata spacing defects. Current-plan retrieval is intentional, and the three not-fetched entries have plausible URL patterns without evidence of a wrong URL; the 2722 not-fetched offerings limit conclusions about institution-wide coverage.

findings.description: Metadata values run together in two of eight displayed plans: PPFD201 joins the frequency to the first-offering sentence without whitespace, and M30-LUN joins profile-specific frequency and teaching-period sentences after punctuation. This is a minor readability defect missed by the pre-pass; the substantive sections remain readable and no missing plan content is demonstrated.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NMBU facts selected in R/institution_config.R are serialized by the HTML block reader in R/blocks.R. Adjacent inline fragments without explicit whitespace may be concatenated; the packet alone cannot establish whether the missing separators originate in source markup or extraction.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a narrowly scoped NMBU normalization in R/institution_config.R post_fn (implemented in R/extract_fulltext.R) for the observed metadata boundaries: separate ÅrligTilbys and insert a newline before Profesjonsmaster PPU when it follows sentence punctuation on Frekvens or Undervisnings- og vurderingsperiode lines. Preserve all metadata text.
